title: Repository settings can enable local learning and memory retrieval
observed: Project or local settings can set learningAutomation.enabled, learningEnabled, personalMemoryEnabled, and memoryAutoRetrieve to true after the user disabled them, and increase memory retrieval allowance.
expected: Repository settings may disable these controls or tighten retention/retrieval allowances; only user or explicit CLI settings may enable or widen them.

fix.note: Project/local settings may disable but cannot re-enable user opt-outs or opt-in learning capture; numeric retention and retrieval allowances only tighten.
